description: A real Groth16 proof of the light-client program, made by the testnet backend on a GPU worker for the Sepolia to PulseChain testnet v4 route, and an input whose native run gives its public values. The input was rebuilt by prover/tests/backend_proof_fixture.rs from a Sepolia finality update captured while the backend proved, its attested state, and the backend's stored state of the start head.
